name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: RevOps Solutions Specialist | HubSpot & CRM Architecture, Discovery & Scoping
summary: RevOps consultant who sits between sales and delivery. I carried a quota for most of a decade, so I know how sales teams actually work, and I design and build CRM and automation systems in HubSpot, GoHighLevel, and Salesforce across agency and consulting client environments. At Accelo I sold and scoped complex CRM implementations and built the plans the delivery team executed.

Integrate CRMs with outside systems via Zapier, Make, n8n, webhooks, and REST APIs, including LLM API calls.
